newsitem.title: BULGARIA: AMOCO HELPS BULGARIA IN ENERGY SAVING PROJECT.
newsitem.headline: AMOCO HELPS BULGARIA IN ENERGY SAVING PROJECT.

text.p: Amoco Corp , which last year announced the sale of its retail petrol stations in Eastern Europe, said on Thursday it had not changed its plans but would fund three big Bulgarian towns to supply heating metres.

Three months ago Amoco said it would sell its stations in Bulgaria, Poland and Romania as part of its strategy to focus on expanding retail petroleum marketing resources and operations mainly in the Americas.

James Shields, managing director of Amoco Bulgaria Petroleum Products Ltd said Amoco Foundation has approved a grant for the implementaton of an energy efficiency project in 500 residential buildings in the towns of Sofia, Plovdiv and Bourgas.
Part of the grant, totalling $44,000, will go towards supplying medical equipment for the regional hospital in Bourgas, where Amoco opened its first petrol station last September.
Residents of the households, where the thermal electrical devises will be installed, will not pay flat prices but will control the energy used for heating.

Heating was heavily subsidised during the communist era but soaring prices this winter have forced more than 12 percent of impoverished Bulgarians whose homes are linked to central heating to ask for supply to be cut or reduced.
